floor_null_path.name: floor-null graphical-position fallback
floor_null_path.behavior: If find_floor returns NULL, MarioState pos is copied from marioObj graphical pos before a second floor query.
floor_null_path.static_assessment: No TTC-native writer of the approximately 3155.25-unit graphical/physical Y divergence was found.
floor_null_path.scope_limit: The positive control injects both an out-of-bounds physical position and a divergent graphical position. The natural result covers only a stopped-clock Wafel bootstrap/controller domain.

platform_mechanism.reason: TTC_SPEED_STOPPED gives the spinner zero angular velocity, and platform displacement does not apply oVelY

single_bit_y_scan.scope_limit: The comparison uses the synthetic event state and does not recover the incident's unknown complete state.

fresh_reassessment.scope_limit: The fresh state is hash-bound to the retained generated route and matching base savestate, but it is not VOD-fitted and the copyrighted savestate and full aggregate remain outside tracked files.

scope_limits: Fuzzy64 pure-interpreter semantics do not implement physical R4300i cache-coherency behavior or physical DRAM and bus faults.
RDP plugin-side framebuffer writes that bypass core memory handlers are outside the trace patch.

route_local.scope_limit: Only multiply pairs whose two dynamic sequence rows occur in retained 64-instruction Mario-Y-write rings are tested; gaps between rings remain unobserved. Conservative first-source eligibility uses either recorded low32 or high32 word because the separately captured ft single value does not resolve the active lane.

rom_static.conclusion: No static back-to-back R4300 multiply-erratum pair exists among the 305935 matched JP R4300 CPU .text words plus the one explicitly included boundary delay word; therefore operand-value and dynamic auditing are vacuous for that static scope.
rom_static.scope_limit: The recognized R4300i/MIPS III decoder and matched CPU .text scope do not cover unobserved route gaps, runtime-loaded or generated CPU code outside that scope, or physical hardware faults. The recorded source revision is a commit-ID match, not a clean-tree attestation.

floor_null_graphical_position_audit.scope_limit: The positive control proves legal propagation of an injected divergence; the bounded natural run does not establish global unreachability, an incident-compatible precursor, or a historical initiator.

evidence_layers.direct_observation: Lossy composited VOD pixels, encoded-frame timestamps, course/mission context, and visible screen-space motion.
evidence_layers.conditional_reconstruction: The C5837800-to-C4837800 mutation, spinner identity/contact, exact Y/X/Z, action, velocity, camera, clock state, and synthetic trajectory.
evidence_layers.etiology: Software propagation/corruption, R4300 execution anomaly, cache/bus/RDRAM transient, power/EMI, or deliberate edit remain hypotheses.

vod_cadence.scope_limit: Encoded H.264 frames do not recover original N64 VIs or game updates.

vod_rendered_candidate_fit.temporal_mapping: Both analyzers use exact source-PTS offsets from encoded event frame 431 in nominal 1001-PTS units. The 2002-PTS gap from encoded 478 to 479 is retained; encoded indices are labels, not assumed source-frame ordinals or N64 VIs.

scene_fit.scope_limit: No known-positive VOD-to-Glide64mk2 pair calibrates renderer, lighting, and texture transfer. The low cross-domain scores cannot distinguish that domain shift from scene, camera, or state mismatch, so they are diagnostic rather than rejections.

motion_fit.scope_limit: The fixed red/blue localizer has no image-level cross-domain positive control. Score failures are diagnostic only, repeated emulator screenshots count once per emitted observation, and no screen-space result identifies Mario RAM, a mutation mechanism, or original-N64 timing.

alignment.formula: highlight_decoded_index = target_timeline_index + integer_offset; target_timeline_index is derived from source PTS in nominal 1001-tick units

highlight_motion_audit.scope_limit: This is an evidence-quality failure, not a rejection of any emulator scenario. The two lossy encodes and fixed color/temporal localizer support no game-state, mechanism, RAM, emulator-scenario, or N64-VI inference; ambiguous and failed localizations remain null.

vod_rendered_candidate_fit.assessment: None of the three exact rendered scenarios is confirmed or excluded by this visual fit. The higher-resolution highlight aligned deterministically but failed its predeclared localization-coverage improvement gate, so the three scenarios were not refitted. These results narrow the tested image and motion domains but do not fit the incident state.

fresh_reassessment.highest_information_next_experiment: The higher-resolution highlight failed its predeclared localization-coverage improvement gate, so do not refit the three rendered scenarios from it. Next acquire an incident-compatible savestate or calibrated cross-domain VOD-to-Glide64mk2 positive pair; without one, additional rendering and visual-fit searches cannot discriminate state mismatch from renderer/encode shift. If hardware etiology remains in scope, test other CPU/cache/RDRAM fault classes on original hardware or a cycle-accurate model; the documented back-to-back multiply erratum has no static site in the matched CPU-code scope.

conclusion.result: Clearing bit 24 of 0xC5837800 produces 0xC4837800, divides Y by four, and reproduces the published 3155.25-unit displacement in the synthetic model. This is the strongest conditional numeric reconstruction, not a directly observed incident RAM transition.
conclusion.what_is_solved: Given the reconstructed input state, that injected mutation reproduces the numeric displacement, recomputed floor and ceiling, falling trajectory, and upper landing with matching native-Wafel and N64-emulator states.
conclusion.normal_gameplay_mechanic_assessment: No tested natural game-code path produced the conditional target. The floor-null positive control propagated an injected incident-scale graphical/physical divergence, but static analysis found no TTC-native producer and a 4096-update stopped-clock controller-only run recorded no branch hit. A fresh complete 196304-candidate one-update campaign again found no rise of at least 500 units. Normal gameplay is still not excluded because scene and screen-space-motion fits of the exact reachable, synthetic no-flip, and synthetic bit-clear renders are all indeterminate and do not cover other incident states.
conclusion.deterministic_exploit_status: No reproducible normal-gameplay trigger or start-to-finish .m64 was found. This analysis does not claim the historical bounty.
conclusion.mechanism_confidence: high that the injected bit clear reproduces the conditional model; undetermined for the historical incident mechanism
conclusion.initiating_agent: not identifiable from the surviving video, software, or hardware evidence

initiator_assessment.explanation: Transient hardware/data-path upset in RDRAM, CPU cache/register state, a bus, power, or EMI
initiator_assessment.assessment: compatible with a one-bit value change but not directly evidenced and not currently distinguishable from uncovered software propagation or corruption

no static pair exists among the 305935 matched JP R4300 CPU .text words plus one required boundary delay word; this bounded exclusion does not cover runtime-loaded or generated code outside that scope or other physical CPU faults

initiator_assessment.explanation: An undiscovered software propagation or memory-corruption path
initiator_assessment.assessment: logically possible, but the floor-null positive control requires injected graphical/physical divergence, no TTC-native producer of that divergence was found, and the bounded natural runtime probe recorded no branch execution

initiator_assessment.explanation: Deliberate memory editing or edited footage
initiator_assessment.assessment: technically capable of the same state change, but unsupported by the continuous race recording

conclusion.cosmic_ray_assessment: An ionizing-particle single-event upset is one possible hardware initiator, not a demonstrated cause. The evidence cannot distinguish it from other electrical or hardware transients.
conclusion.cartridge_contact_assessment: The runner reported unreliable cartridge contact, but the ROM cartridge bus does not directly select Mario's live RDRAM Y word. The anecdote supports only a generic hardware-instability possibility, not this specific mutation.
